official_name.value: Maastricht University, School of Business and Economics

eligible_majors.notes: Excel agreement scope specifies AUC School 'BUS' rather than specific majors.

english_course_availability.notes: SBE exchange curriculum is taught in English via Problem-Based Learning (PBL).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: SBE utilizes English-taught Problem-Based Learning tutorials requiring strong English proficiency, but exact official SBE numeric test cutoffs or RHET 1020 waiver rules are not directly published on https://www.maastrichtuniversity.nl/education/exchange/sbe (local Drive fact sheet folder is blocked).

host_language_requirement.notes: Classes are taught in English; no official Dutch language requirement stated for SBE exchange.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall Semester 2026: Period 1 Aug 31 - Oct 23, 2026; Period 2 Oct 26 - Dec 18, 2026; Period 3 (skills period) Jan 4 - Jan 29, 2027.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring Semester 2027: Period 4 Feb 1 - Apr 2, 2027; Period 5 Apr 5 - Jun 4, 2027 (select faculties start Period 5 Mar 29; Period 6 follows in June).

tuition_model.notes: Incoming exchange students officially nominated by a partner university do not pay tuition fees to Maastricht University's SBE and continue paying tuition to their home university.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived from UM official Nibud monthly student expense breakdown: Rent EUR 561 + Groceries EUR 272 + Books/materials EUR 53 + Transport EUR 67 + Leisure/sports EUR 238 + Clothing EUR 60 + Phone/internet EUR 55 = EUR 1,306/month excluding health insurance, or EUR 1,462/month including EUR 156/month health insurance. Separately, Dutch IND visa proof of means is EUR 1,250/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint EUR 1,384.00/month (EUR 1,306 excl. insurance to EUR 1,462 incl. EUR 156/mo health insurance from UM Nibud breakdown) * 5 months = EUR 6,920.00; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 7,647.98 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition fees are waived for nominated partner exchange students (non-partner fee-paying freemover exchange is not permitted at SBE). Non-EEA visa/residence permit applicants incur Dutch IND administrative fees (est. ~EUR 250+). Health insurance coverage is mandatory (UM Nibud table cites EUR 156/month; semester optional insurance/books/misc noted at ~EUR 300-500).

housing_availability.notes: Students book furnished short-stay UM Guesthouse rooms or private rooms through Maastricht Housing portal on a first-come, first-served basis.

housing_notes.value: UM Guesthouse offers furnished single/double rooms and studios (minimum 3-month stay for exchange students; semester housing estimates ~EUR 3,600-6,200) via https://www.maastrichtuniversity.nl/about-um/um-guesthouse-and-maastrichthousingcom. Reservations require a 30-day rent down payment and one-time cleaning fee of EUR 60, EUR 75, or EUR 100.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students staying >90 days require an MVV entry visa and/or VVR residence permit submitted by Maastricht University as recognized IND sponsor (visa@maastrichtuniversity.nl). Applicants must show financial proof of EUR 1,250/month (e.g., EUR 6,250 for 5 months; EUR 15,000 for 12 months) via bank statements, scholarship, sponsorship, or refundable UM living-allowance deposit.

exchange_page_url.notes: See also SBE Bachelor exchange overview: https://www.maastrichtuniversity.nl/education/bachelor/exchanges-sbe.

english_course_list_url.notes: Filter by SBE / Non-Degree / Exchange tracks in the UM Course Descriptions Application.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; standard full-time semester workload at Maastricht University is 30 ECTS across modular periods.

course_restrictions_note.value: Only students officially nominated by an active SBE partner university may attend SBE on exchange (freemover / non-partner fee-paying study abroad students cannot enroll at SBE).

required_application_docs.notes: Local Drive fact sheet folder is blocked; full checklist is sent post-nomination.

academic_style.value: Small-group Problem-Based Learning (PBL) tutorial system (~12-15 students per group) emphasizing active discussion, case work, and modular 8-week periods plus optional 2-week skills periods.

international_support_services.value: UM Visa Office (visa@maastrichtuniversity.nl), SBE International Relations Office, and UM Guesthouse / Maastricht Housing services.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall semester: Nomination April 15; Application May 1. Spring semester: Nomination September 15; Application October 1.
